summary_en: 5,003,341 shares to be cancelled on Aug 6, 2026, representing 8.2% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury). Comprises 372,641 treasury shares held as of Mar 31, 2026 and 4,630,700 shares to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 buyback. Post-cancellation outstanding share count: 56,213,059.
title_en: Notice of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Marvelous Inc. announced on July 31, 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to cancel 5,003,341 treasury shares under Article 178 of the Companies Act. The cancellation is effective August 6, 2026. The shares comprise 372,641 shares currently held in treasury as of March 31, 2026, and 4,630,700 shares (upper limit) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 trading (announced on the same day). The company stated the purpose is to improve capital efficiency and shareholder value. Post-cancellation, shares outstanding (excluding treasury) will be 56,213,059.
